note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation in this teen edition was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS wording (and the shipped works' wording reused for 1 Corinthians 6:19 and 1 Peter 1:5) the first translation carried; the UBS credit line is no longer owed for this work.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; a verbatim recitation without quote marks counts (founder rule, 2026-11-19). `self_rendered` rows each carry a `why`.

The full edition (absolute-surrender.am.json) was re-quoted first (PR #9929); this edition quotes each shared verse with the same OWB span: 1 Kings 20:4 «ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፣ እንዳሉት ነው። እኔም ያለኝም ሁሉ የእርስዎ ነን።», Mark 9:24 «አምናለሁ! አለማመኔን እርዳ!», 1 Peter 1:5 «የእግዚአብሔር ኃይል በእምነት ይጠብቃችኋል», Galatians 5:22 «መንፈስ የሚያፈራው ፍሬ ግን ፍቅር» ነው, Luke 18:27, Romans 7:19-25, Galatians 3:3, Acts 13:2 and John 15:5 as OWB words them. The chapter-6 epigraph now cites Galatians 5:22-23, since OWB (like the KJV) puts the last two fruits in verse 23. The chapter-9 closing prayer joins OWB's Romans 7:24 and 7:25 with '…'. Study-question answers quoting a verse were brought to the same OWB wording.

Murray's own sentences are reused from the shipped full edition wherever the teen text quotes them, so a few keep Murray's plural address (እናንተ) inside the quotation while the teen prose speaks to one reader (አንተ).
